# Ankhorage k3s Infrastructure

![license: MIT](././paradox/badges/license.svg) ![npm: v0.4.5](././paradox/badges/npm.svg) ![runtime: bun](././paradox/badges/runtime.svg) ![typescript: strict](././paradox/badges/typescript.svg) ![eslint: checked](././paradox/badges/eslint.svg) ![prettier: checked](././paradox/badges/prettier.svg) ![build: checked](././paradox/badges/build.svg) ![tests: configured](././paradox/badges/tests.svg) ![paradox: warnings](././paradox/badges/docs.svg)

Adapts portable infrastructure intent to k3s clusters on local Linux or host-key-pinned SSH nodes.

Provide a standalone k3s runtime adapter while delegating standard Kubernetes workload behavior to the shared Kubernetes driver.

## Public API

### Utilities

<details>
<summary>createInfraAdapter</summary>

```ts
createInfraAdapter(options?: K3sAdapterOptions) => InfraRuntimeAdapter<"k3s">
```

Create the canonical k3s runtime adapter entrypoint.

The default composition bootstraps local Linux or host-key-pinned SSH nodes through the official
k3s installer. Standard workload projection and reconciliation are delegated to the published
Kubernetes driver. Canonical `networking.tls` ACME HTTP-01 intent is reconciled through an
Infra-owned Traefik HelmChartConfig without overwriting foreign Traefik configuration. Tests and
specialized hosts may inject the control-plane boundary.
